decided: The concepts page's glossary names the new capability for the brief among the capabilities it relies on only at this change's archive, once the capability is in the project's specs; the rest of that page's change was made now.
alternatives: name it now, leaving the check on the concepts page failing until the archive
leave it off the line for good
why: The concepts page's check accepts only a capability the project's specs already hold, and the new capability joins them only when the archive syncs it; leaving it off for good would let the glossary's line about saved briefs rest on no named capability.

relies_on.title: Every H2 section of four concept pages declares its owner on a checked Carried by line

detail: docs/concepts.md's glossary Carried by line gains `orbit-program-brief` after the sync; design.md's At archive section and task 4.1 say so. test/helpers/user-docs.ts capabilityExists reads only orbit/specs/<name>/spec.md.
